name: IMAP
description: Windows MDM settings in the IMAP category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Turn on purge when switching folders (User)
properties.description: When "purge on switch" is enabled, IMAP e-mail messages marked for deletion in the current folder will be permanently removed from the server when the user switches to another folder. This setting will allow you to enable the IMAP "purge on switch" feature.
